# VARIABLE ALIGNMENT

Set the alignment of variables in the data grid.

## Syntax

```text
VARIABLE ALIGNMENT varlist (LEFT | RIGHT | CENTER) [[/] varlist (...) ...].
```

## Example

```text
VARIABLE ALIGNMENT id (LEFT) / q1 TO q5 (CENTER).
```

`statscraft help VARIABLE ALIGNMENT` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
